method.field_policy: Explicit selected scalar fields and bounded lists; complete environment records and raw machine payloads excluded.
method.hash_policy: Six explicitly selected existing files, 288022 bytes total; no recursive hashing or large raw-log traversal.

driver.failure_propagation: A failed paired invocation continues with the next profile; qualification/residency return booleans are not accumulated into a final failing exit code.

coverage.cpp: Linked C++ new/delete requested bytes and corresponding CRT usable storage only; direct malloc, SDL, driver and OS heaps are excluded.
coverage.prepare: Recorded fresh-process cumulative concurrent product allocation-origin peak through host load and per-origin peaks; not a complete semantic prepare-only or decoded-heap upper bound. Do not add per-domain peaks.
coverage.lifetime: Available memory summaries retain semantic rating unrated and complete_semantic_graph false. Final product new-book requested bytes are zero; the ownership release validator covers a tracked registry subset only.
coverage.gpu_logical: GL buffers and RGBA8 textures only; shaders, driver and framebuffer excluded. Every available device memory summary reports peak 72 bytes and final logical count/storage zero.
coverage.gpu_residency: Only device-64-low/high have accepted-by-collector sampled residency summaries. Same-process initialized empty renderer baseline, Dedicated+Shared process GPU usage. Complete sampled load-through-close coverage does not establish a continuous or transient peak bound.
coverage.missing: device-2048-low pair-3-memory has no process.json or summary.json; its qualification and residency were skipped. device-2048-high residency has process exit 0 but no summary.json following runtime environment failure. Unknown values remain null.
